page.overview:
Who is James Cleanair?

James Cleanair is a character in Cars. He races for the team "Vitoline".

"Vitoline, a fuel additive vitamin company, provides fuel for older active cars. Sponsoring a race car seemed like a good way to get that message across to their customers, and they hired the right car for the job! Senior racer James Cleanair has been racing for twenty years and shows no signs of slowing down!"

James Cleanair appears in Cars: The Video Game, with the name Aikens. In Palm Mile Speedway, he finished in 15th place; in Motor Speedway of the South, he finished in 15th place; in Sun Valley International Speedway, he finished in 7th place; in Smasherville International Speedway, he finished in 2nd place and in Los Angeles International Speedway, he finished in 7th place.
